title: Taylor explicit runtime, contact, and hourglass sanity
objective: Add the internal explicit Taylor runtime surface with reduced Hex8, hourglass force use, and rigid-wall contact.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E7 Taylor impact runtime scope and acceptance criteria.

scope: Add internal explicit update loop for Taylor impact smoke cases.
Use reduced Hex8 and existing Flanagan-Belytschko hourglass force.
Do not expose the public Taylor benchmark runner yet.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing existing hourglass or explicit-dynamics symbols.
Implement a benchmark-local explicit update kernel/helper.
Wire reduced Hex8 and hourglass force into the runtime sanity path.
Implement rigid-wall contact with penetration prevention.
Add tests for hourglass boundedness and contact behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Reduced Hex8 hourglass energy remains bounded in a non-impact sanity case.
No Johnson-Cook or hourglass behavior changes are made unless proved necessary.
risks: Taylor impact combines several runtime capabilities; mitigate by keeping this task runtime-only and testing contact/hourglass behavior before material postprocessing.
completion_notes: Added mechdsl.verify.benchmarks._taylor_runtime (NumPy-only): ExplicitTaylorState, RigidWallSpec, init_taylor_runtime, explicit_step, apply_rigid_wall_contact, hourglass_energy_increment.
Energy bookkeeping accumulates absolute |f.du| for monotonic non-negative dissipation budgets so the AC-1 boundedness ratio is well-defined under oscillatory motion.
ExplicitTaylorState exposes a free-form material_state dict so P7-2 can attach Johnson-Cook arrays without restructuring the dataclass.
rho parameter retained on explicit_step signature (currently unused — mass precomputed at init) for future variable-density support without a breaking signature change.
